title: GNU Wget archipelago
subtitle: Modules of GNU Wget as island cities · bridges follow #include and link dependencies · hover for details, click to focus

islands.label: Command line
islands.description: Parses options and .wgetrc into the global `opt` struct, then hands each URL to the retrieval engine and maps the outcome to an exit status.

islands.label: Retrieval
islands.description: The download loop: fetches one URL through the right protocol, follows redirects, crawls recursively, honours robots.txt and reports broken links in --spider mode.

islands.label: HTTP
islands.description: HTTP/1.1 client: requests, headers, authentication (Basic, Digest, NTLM), proxies, redirects, resumable downloads and content-disposition.

islands.label: FTP
islands.description: FTP and FTPS client: control-channel commands, passive/active data connections, directory-listing parsers for many server flavours and OPIE one-time passwords.

islands.label: URLs & IRIs
islands.description: Parses, merges and escapes URLs, maps them to local file names, and converts internationalised domain names and IRIs.

islands.label: Link extraction
islands.description: A tolerant HTML tokenizer and a flex-generated CSS lexer that find the links recursive downloads should follow.

islands.label: Link conversion
islands.description: Rewrites links in downloaded pages so the mirror browses offline (-k, --convert-links) and backs up originals (-K).

islands.label: Cookies
islands.description: Cookie jar: parses Set-Cookie, applies domain and path rules with the public-suffix list, and loads or saves Netscape cookie files.

islands.label: HSTS
islands.description: Remembers HTTP Strict Transport Security policies in a local database and upgrades matching http:// URLs to https://.

islands.label: TLS
islands.description: One TLS interface (ssl.h) with two interchangeable backends chosen at build time: GnuTLS or OpenSSL.

islands.label: Credentials
islands.description: Reads ~/.netrc to find login credentials for hosts.

islands.label: Sockets & DNS
islands.description: Opens and binds sockets with timeouts, resolves host names (optionally through c-ares) and caches DNS answers.

islands.label: Progress & logging
islands.description: Progress bar and dot indicators, the logging layer behind -o/-a/-q, and extended attributes recording where a file came from.

islands.label: WARC writer
islands.description: Writes requests and responses to Web ARChive files for web archiving (--warc-file).

islands.label: Metalink
islands.description: Downloads from Metalink descriptions: mirror selection, piece hashes and signature checks.

islands.label: Utilities
islands.description: Shared helpers used everywhere: string and file utilities, hash tables, precise timers and the project-wide headers.

islands.label: Windows & VMS ports
islands.description: Platform glue for Windows and OpenVMS builds.

islands.label: gnulib
islands.description: The GNU portability library, vendored as a submodule; wget imports 102 of its modules (size = modules listed in bootstrap.conf).

islands.label: Perl test suite
islands.description: Legacy Perl suite that runs the built wget binary against local HTTP/FTP test servers, plus C unit tests of internal functions.

islands.label: Python test suite
islands.description: Python test environment with scripted HTTP(S) and FTP servers that checks wget's behaviour end to end.

islands.label: Fuzzers
islands.description: libFuzzer and AFL targets for the parsers most exposed to hostile input; the corpora are not counted.

islands.label: GnuTLS
islands.description: Default TLS backend. Size = wget source files that include it.

islands.label: OpenSSL
islands.description: Alternative TLS backend, also usable for NTLM hashing. Size = wget source files that include it.

islands.label: Nettle
islands.description: Crypto primitives (MD4, DES) for NTLM when built with GnuTLS. Size = wget source files that include it.

islands.label: zlib
islands.description: gzip decompression of HTTP responses and compressed WARC output. Size = wget source files that include it.

islands.label: libpsl
islands.description: Public-suffix list lookups so cookies cannot be set for a whole TLD. Size = wget source files that include it.

islands.label: libidn2
islands.description: Internationalised domain name conversion. Size = wget source files that include it.

islands.label: PCRE2
islands.description: Perl-compatible regular expressions for --accept-regex and --reject-regex. Size = wget source files that include it.

islands.label: c-ares
islands.description: Optional asynchronous DNS resolver. Size = wget source files that include it.

islands.label: libuuid
islands.description: Record ids for WARC files. Size = wget source files that include it.

islands.label: libmetalink + GPGME
islands.description: Metalink document parsing and OpenPGP signature verification. Size = wget source files that include them.

bridges.title: Start downloads
bridges.description: main() hands every URL on the command line or in -i files to retrieve_url() or retrieve_tree().

bridges.title: HTTP defaults
bridges.description: Option handling configures HTTP-specific behaviour and saves cookies and HSTS state on exit.

bridges.title: DNS and bind options
bridges.description: Applies --bind-address, --dns-servers and address-family preferences.

bridges.title: Progress style
bridges.description: Selects the progress implementation (--progress=bar|dot) and log destination.

bridges.title: Convert links at exit
bridges.description: After all downloads finish, main() runs link conversion over the downloaded set.

bridges.title: Load HSTS store
bridges.description: Opens and later saves the HSTS database (--hsts-file).

bridges.title: TLS options
bridges.description: Passes certificate, key, CA and protocol options to the TLS layer.

bridges.title: Credential lookup
bridges.description: Enables .netrc lookups for hosts without explicit credentials.

bridges.title: Open WARC file
bridges.description: Initialises and closes WARC output around the whole run.

bridges.title: Metalink input
bridges.description: Parses --input-metalink files and downloads their resources.

bridges.title: Parse arguments
bridges.description: Turns command-line arguments into parsed URLs.

bridges.title: Helpers
bridges.description: String, file and memory helpers.

bridges.title: Async resolver setup
bridges.description: Initialises the c-ares channel when built with it.

bridges.title: http_loop()
bridges.description: HTTP and HTTPS URLs are fetched through http_loop(), which handles retries and redirects.

bridges.title: ftp_loop()
bridges.description: FTP and FTPS URLs are fetched through ftp_loop(), including directory recursion.

bridges.title: Resolve and merge URLs
bridges.description: Parses redirect targets and merges relative links during crawling.

bridges.title: Find links to follow
bridges.description: Recursive mode asks the HTML and CSS extractors for the links inside each downloaded page.

bridges.title: Register downloads
bridges.description: Records which URLs map to which local files so links can be converted later.

bridges.title: Read from sockets
bridges.description: fd_read_body() and friends read response bodies with timeouts and rate limiting.

bridges.title: Report progress
bridges.description: Feeds byte counts to the progress indicator while bodies download.

bridges.title: HSTS upgrade
bridges.description: Checks the HSTS store before following a URL.

bridges.title: gzip bodies
bridges.description: Decompresses gzip-encoded response bodies on the fly.

bridges.title: Connect
bridges.description: Opens connections to origins and proxies and reuses persistent ones.

bridges.title: HTTPS handshake
bridges.description: Wraps the socket in TLS for https:// URLs and CONNECT tunnels.

bridges.title: Cookie jar
bridges.description: Adds Cookie headers to requests and stores Set-Cookie responses.

bridges.title: Record HSTS
bridges.description: Stores Strict-Transport-Security headers from HTTPS responses.

bridges.title: Credentials
bridges.description: Looks up user and password for authenticated hosts.

bridges.title: Body transfer
bridges.description: Uses the shared body-reading and retry helpers of the retrieval engine.

bridges.title: Archive exchange
bridges.description: Copies raw requests and responses into the WARC file when enabled.

bridges.title: Metalink headers
bridges.description: Follows Link and Digest headers that point to Metalink mirrors.

bridges.title: Adjust extensions
bridges.description: Registers downloaded HTML and CSS so their links and file extensions can be fixed.

bridges.title: Record origin
bridges.description: Writes origin URL metadata as extended attributes (--xattr).

bridges.title: NTLM crypto
bridges.description: MD4 and DES for NTLM authentication in GnuTLS builds.

bridges.title: NTLM crypto
bridges.description: MD4 and DES for NTLM authentication in OpenSSL builds.

bridges.title: Control and data sockets
bridges.description: Opens the control connection and passive or active data connections.

bridges.title: FTPS
bridges.description: Upgrades control and data channels to TLS for ftps:// URLs.

bridges.title: Credentials
bridges.description: Looks up FTP logins in .netrc.

bridges.title: Body transfer
bridges.description: Uses the shared body-reading helpers and recursion rules.

bridges.title: Listing to URLs
bridges.description: Turns directory-listing entries into URLs to fetch.

bridges.title: Archive transfers
bridges.description: Records FTP transfers as WARC resource records.

bridges.title: Resolve links
bridges.description: Resolves every href, src and url() against the page's base URL.

bridges.title: Link positions
bridges.description: Records where each link sits in the file so conversion can rewrite it in place.

bridges.title: Re-parse pages
bridges.description: Re-reads downloaded HTML and CSS to rewrite links for offline browsing.

bridges.title: Relative paths
bridges.description: Computes relative local paths between downloaded files.

bridges.title: Public suffixes
bridges.description: Rejects cookies scoped to a public suffix such as .co.uk.

bridges.title: Host checks
bridges.description: Skips IP-literal hosts, which HSTS does not apply to.

bridges.title: Socket transport
bridges.description: Registers TLS read and write functions on the connection's file descriptor.

bridges.title: GnuTLS backend
bridges.description: gnutls.c implements the ssl.h interface on GnuTLS.

bridges.title: OpenSSL backend
bridges.description: openssl.c implements the ssl.h interface on OpenSSL.

bridges.title: Async DNS
bridges.description: Resolves names through c-ares when available, with timeouts.

bridges.title: IDN conversion
bridges.description: Converts Unicode host names to their ASCII (punycode) form.

bridges.title: Compressed WARC
bridges.description: Writes gzip-compressed WARC records.

bridges.title: Record ids
bridges.description: Generates WARC-Record-ID values.

bridges.title: Parse and verify
bridges.description: Parses Metalink XML and checks detached OpenPGP signatures.

bridges.title: Fetch pieces
bridges.description: Downloads each resource from its mirrors through the normal retrieval path.

bridges.title: Transfer state
bridges.description: Reads download totals and rates to draw the progress bar.

bridges.title: Regex filters
bridges.description: Compiles --accept-regex and --reject-regex patterns.

bridges.title: Portability layer
bridges.description: String, file, time and hashing functions come from gnulib modules.

bridges.title: getopt and friends
bridges.description: Option parsing, getpass and quoting helpers come from gnulib.

bridges.title: Shared helpers
bridges.description: Windows and VMS glue builds on the common utilities.

bridges.title: End-to-end runs
bridges.description: Runs the built binary with scripted options against local servers and checks downloaded files.

bridges.title: End-to-end runs
bridges.description: Starts HTTP(S)/FTP test servers, runs wget and checks files, headers and exit codes.

bridges.title: NTLM fuzzer
bridges.description: wget_ntlm_fuzzer feeds hostile NTLM challenges to the HTTP auth code.

bridges.title: FTP listing fuzzer
bridges.description: wget_ftpls_fuzzer throws malformed directory listings at the parsers.

bridges.title: HTML and CSS fuzzers
bridges.description: wget_html_fuzzer and wget_css_fuzzer exercise the link extractors.

bridges.title: Cookie fuzzer
bridges.description: wget_cookie_fuzzer parses arbitrary Set-Cookie headers.

bridges.title: URL fuzzer
bridges.description: wget_url_fuzzer parses arbitrary URLs.

bridges.title: robots.txt and read_hunk fuzzers
bridges.description: Fuzzes robots.txt parsing and fd_read_hunk(), which reads header blocks off the socket.

bridges.title: netrc fuzzer
bridges.description: wget_netrc_fuzzer parses arbitrary .netrc files.

bridges.title: Options fuzzer
bridges.description: wget_options_fuzzer feeds random option strings to the parser.

bridges.title: Progress fuzzer
bridges.description: wget_progress_fuzzer drives the progress bar with random sizes and widths.
